parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish آرمود (armud, armut), from a Caucasian substrate, compare Persian ارمود (armud), امرود (amrud).

parole.significato: a guide, in the plain general or abstract sense
parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish قلاغوز (kılağuz), from Old Anatolian Turkish قلاغوز (qulağuz, qulavuz), from an extinct Central Asiatic substrate.
